given: The notes hold a forming decision 'ship Monday'; anyone in the room can fix the record live.
when: 'Proxy, we decided Friday, not Monday — that's final' is spoken.
then: The correction applies as an immediate attributed superseded-not-erased patch (old value kept), the correction requires corrector identity + timestamp (else AttributionError before any write), and because it sets Decision.status=final the notes-injection gate ALSO emits a one-line spoken receipt (audible confirm) — while ordinary firmness bumps stay silent-immediate.
